supported: ClusterDecoration draws each symbol's asBig TextBlock after applying RectangleArea.getPosition().

SvekResult.calculateDimension measures the fully drawn result and calls one clusterManager.moveDelta(6 - minX, 6 - minY), so the frontier translation is diagram-wide rather than an enclosed-entity adjustment.

source_inspection.rejected_assumption: The implementation treats positioning the rectangle border at the normalized RectangleArea origin as sufficient. USymbolRectangle.asBig also positions its title at local y = 2 + stereotype height. Rust leaves emit_layout_rectangle_cluster at cluster.y + PACKAGE_TITLE_BASELINE + 1.0, placing the title one pixel below Java after the origin correction.

findings.summary: The global painted-frontier model is supported by the inspected Java data flow, but the Rust realization is incomplete for rectangle symbols.
findings.evidence: Three independent class-renderer perturbations with an outer rectangle fail only at the title: y is exactly one pixel too large in both directions and when a frame or node competes to own the root envelope. Frame and node equivalents pass.

findings.summary: The rectangle error is mechanism-relevant, not a fixture-shaped discrepancy.
findings.evidence: USymbolRectangle.asBig draws its title from the same translated local origin as its URectangle. Rust class.rs:6183 retains +1.0 after the border was moved to cluster.y, while Java USymbolRectangle.java:133 uses local y=2 plus stereotype height. The failure survives direction, label, topology, and sibling-envelope changes.

findings.summary: No overfitting signal was found in the implementation diff.
findings.evidence: Static inspection found no reference to fixture labels or golden paths and no output embedding or per-fixture branch logic. The defect is a general unported primitive-local translation.

findings.summary: The quoted raw frame/node forms expose separate Rust class-dispatch and nested-node weaknesses.
findings.evidence: Their Java SVGs and failure pairs are preserved, but the package-stereotype matrix is the controlled mechanism test because it reaches the same class package renderer under an established RustUML spelling.

rejection_basis: Valid fresh rectangle class-package inputs fail the exact no-oracle comparator across both TB and LR directions and with competing root envelope owners.
